title: The Most Populous Countries
short: India (about 1.45 billion in 2024) and China (about 1.42 billion) have the most people, followed by the United States, Indonesia and Pakistan (UN World Population Prospects 2024).
trouble: Students still think China is the most populous country. India passed China in 2023, according to the UN.

blocks.html: Which countries hold most of the world's 8.2 billion people? Here is the UN's list for 2024.

head: Rank

blocks.cap: The ten most populous countries (UN World Population Prospects 2024).

blocks.html: India (about 1.45 billion) and China (about 1.42 billion) are far ahead of everyone else. Then come the United States, Indonesia, Pakistan, Nigeria and Brazil (UN, 2024).

India and China each have more people than North and South America together. Both have long histories of farming on rich river plains, which can feed many people. In recent decades China's birth rate fell sharply, while India's fell more slowly, so India passed China in 2023, according to the UN.

blocks.title: How far ahead?
blocks.q: How many more people did India have than China in 2024?
steps: India: about 1,451 million. China: about 1,419 million.

blocks.title: Africa's giant
blocks.q: Which is the most populous country in Africa?
steps: Ethiopia, the next, has about 132 million.

blocks.title: Where are the ten?
blocks.q: How many of the ten most populous countries are in Asia?
steps: India, China, Indonesia, Pakistan and Bangladesh are in Asia: that is 5.
Nigeria and Ethiopia are in Africa; the United States and Brazil are in the Americas.
Russia spans Europe and Asia; most of its people live in the European part.

blocks.html: Many people still think China has the most people. That was true for centuries, but India passed China in 2023, according to the UN. Always check the year of a population list.
